projects.title: Creator Growth Podcast Episode 12
projects.description: Weekly creator strategy episode focused on short-form growth and content repurposing.

transcript.text: Most creators spend hours chopping a single podcast into clips that still fail to hook in the first two seconds.
transcript.speaker: Host

transcript.text: The winning move is identifying the exact moment where tension, payoff, and audience curiosity all spike together.
transcript.speaker: Host

transcript.text: When we detect emotion in the voice, movement on screen, and a clear promise, the retention curve usually jumps.
transcript.speaker: Host

transcript.text: Then we reframe for vertical, burn in captions, and end with a call to action that matches the topic instead of feeling bolted on.
transcript.speaker: Host

transcript.text: That is how one long-form video becomes ten clips that are coherent, fast, and ready for TikTok, Shorts, and Reels.
transcript.speaker: Host
